uutiset.t: Mahanadi Coalfields’ $953 Million India IPO Subscribed 1.5 Times
uutiset.s: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd.’s $953 million initial public offering was subscribed 1.5 times as bidding closed Monday, driven by strong demand from institutional investors.

uutiset.t: European Banks Set to Fire Up M&A Talks, Morgan Stanley Says
uutiset.s: The success of current deals across Europe’s banking sector and potentially softer regulation is likely to fuel boardroom talks about cross-border acquisitions next year, according to Morgan Stanley analysts.

uutiset.t: Market Volatility May Not Be Enough to Make the Fed Pause: Dawson
uutiset.s: Cameron Dawson, chief investment officer at NewEdge Wealth, discusses the factors that could turn the market correction into a growth scare. Speaking on “Bloomberg Surveillance,” she says there is “likely more pain to be had” before the Federal Reserve reacts to market volatility. (Source: Bloomberg

uutiset.t: Top Cobalt Producer Congo Will Ban Exports Again as Prices Slide
uutiset.s: Top cobalt producer Democratic Republic of Congo will reintroduce a ban on exports of the battery metal from the end of the month, in an effort to reverse slumping prices.

uutiset.t: Tech Companies Are Getting More Creative to Raise Billions
uutiset.s: The biggest tech companies are increasingly finding that to borrow the hundreds of billions of dollars they want to fund artificial intelligence investments, they need to get creative.

uutiset.t: US, UK Firms Cut FX Hedges to Lowest Since 2024 as Losses Jump
uutiset.s: Companies in the US and UK scaled back their currency hedges in the third quarter by the most in more than two years, even as they saw losses from unprotected currency volatility rise, an industry survey shows.

uutiset.t: Wall Street Surges Toward M&A Record as Megadeals Defy Selloff
uutiset.s: Wall Street is taking a big step toward a record year for mergers and acquisitions as some of the world’s largest companies defy a tech-induced selloff in global stocks to pursue major takeovers.

uutiset.t: Wall Street Sees Buying Opportunities for the Brave
uutiset.s: Morgan Stanley’s Michael Wilson says this is the “fat pitch.”

uutiset.t: JPMorgan Traders Drop Bullish View on Stocks After Selloff
uutiset.s: JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s trading desk is taking a cautious view toward US stocks after the S&P 500 Index tumbled into a correction last week.

uutiset.t: Refinery in Southern Russia Halts Operations After Attack
uutiset.s: A small refinery in southern Russia suspended operations following a drone strike as Moscow and Kyiv continued to trade attacks on each other’s energy infrastructure.

uutiset.t: Coca-Cola Bottler Hit by EU Probe Into Abuse of Market Power
uutiset.s: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners Plc, a bottler of soft drinks including Coke, has been hit by a formal European Union antitrust investigation over fears it may have illegally carved up EU markets.

uutiset.t: India Banking Cash Turns to Deficit for First Time Since June
uutiset.s: India’s banking system liquidity slipped into deficit for the first time in about five months, as recent tax outflows reduced cash with lenders.

uutiset.t: Capita Dives 74% as CEO Exit Marks UK Outsourcer’s Downfall
uutiset.s: Capita Plc lost almost three-quarters of its value after the British company parted with its chief executive officer, warned of a fresh hit to profit and moved to issue new equity following growing problems with one of the government’s biggest outsourcing contracts.

uutiset.t: Libyan Oil Pipeline Reopens, Restoring Output at Biggest Field
uutiset.s: A Libyan pipeline carrying crude from the country’s biggest oil field reopened after a brief disruption, restoring a significant proportion of the OPEC member’s output.

uutiset.t: European Gas Surges as Cold Snap Threatens Tight Winter Supplies
uutiset.s: European natural gas prices jumped as a sharply colder weather outlook intensified concerns over Europe’s winter supplies, already under pressure from export disruptions linked to the US-Iran war.
